chapter: Looking back, big bands and sidemen
title: Gerry Mulligan's new band and the effect of his absence
summary: Mulligan is forming a 12 or 14 piece band playing old Concert Jazz Band music; Herman feels his absence from the scene has not helped his playing.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I -- it's interesting that Jerry Mulligan is putting together a band, or attempting to, under the aegis of Mr. Willett and Alexander.
I guess it's a pretty big band, 12 or 14.
Yeah. And he's doing a lot of the old music.
Yeah, that stuff, and even some of the earlier --

And he played a festival with us in Germany, I guess, two or three years ago. And once again, I hope that I'm making myself clear, but I feel that his absence from the scene has not helped him as a player.
I just heard him on a Michel Legrand album, soloing. It was good to hear him.
Wonderful to have him back. Yeah, Nick -- I hope something will move with Nick, because he's a rarity.
Right. And he's in a education.
